label: 2nd-3rd copy outputs of short (L=3-4) sequences
explanation: Fires only in the copy phase, never on original tokens or the <DEL> step, and never on the first copy step (recall_idx 0). Its strong core is short sequences (L=3 or 4) on the steps that output original tokens 1 and 2 (the two steps right after <DEL>, i.e. inputs are orig 0 and orig 1). That core has precision 0.95 and holds about 76% of activation mass on dev; almost all of the top-quartile activations are there, peaking at ~0.09 on L=3 sequences. On L=4 the last copy step (recall_idx 3) fires more weakly and less reliably. In longer sequences (L>=5) it fires weakly and diffusely on about 10% of copy steps, mostly the last three outputs (to_go<=2), slightly more when the input is i or o. That accounts for the lower-quartile activations and is not captured. Token identity only weakly modulates magnitude.
